description: Read a CI/CD pipeline — GitHub Actions, Azure Pipelines, GitLab CI or a declarative Jenkinsfile — and simulate it with the Architecture Simulator's CI/CD engine: jobs and their dependencies (what runs in parallel stays parallel), lead time p50/p95 split into execution and WAITING FOR A RUNNER (the usual hidden culprit), runner utilization, deploys per day, cost per month and the DORA level. The file carries no durations: they are estimated per step type and flagged; pass runsPerDay and runners when you know them.

pipeline.description: The workflow file as text (.github/workflows/*.yml, azure-pipelines.yml, .gitlab-ci.yml or a Jenkinsfile)

runsPerDay.description: How many times a day it runs (default: the trigger's typical value)

name: archsim_from_pipeline
title: Simulate a CI/CD pipeline from its workflow file
